Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I Did It. I Really Did It.

The officials approach George, presenting him with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Mr. George, Congratulations! You have been officially recognized as the Oldest Human to Ever Live.

GEORGE
(smiling)
Thank You. Thank You So Much.

The room erupts in applause as George is mobbed by reporters and well-wishers.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and his mind begins to wander back to his youth.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It Online...

As he recalls the theory, George's expression changes from calm to confused to terrified.

GEORGE
(panicked)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Trapped In A Simulation?

George's eyes widen as he starts to imagine the impossible.

GEORGE
(whispering)
What If I'm The Only One Who Knows The Truth? What If I'm The Only One Who Can Escape?

George's body begins to shake, and he starts to rock back and forth in bed.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I Have To Get Out Of Here. I Have To Find A Way To Escape.

As the night wears on, George's mental state deteriorates further. He starts to hallucinate, seeing multiple versions of himself, all trapped in different simulations.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone At All.

The camera zooms out as George's mind descends into chaos, the sound of his own whispers growing louder and more frantic.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his eyes wide open, his mind shattered. The room is dark, except for a faint glow emanating from the computer on his bedside table.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone At All...

The camera lingers on George's face, his eyes frozen in terror, as the sound of his own whispers grows louder and more intense.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
